declaration.preface:
We at Allchem Lifescience Pvt. Ltd. recognize our responsibility to minimize environmental impacts while maintaining excellence in the manufacturing of pharmaceutical intermediates and specialty chemicals. As a cGMP-compliant organization with ISO 9001:2008, ISO 14000:2004, and OHSAS 18000:2007 certifications, we are committed to integrating sustainable practices across our operations.

Our approach focuses on resource conservation, pollution control, responsible material usage, and regulatory compliance to ensure environmental stewardship in every aspect of our business. We actively seek to enhance energy efficiency, reduce waste generation, and implement cleaner production technologies to mitigate our ecological footprint.

Through continuous improvement, innovation, and collaboration with stakeholders, we aim to uphold the highest standards of environmental responsibility. This policy outlines our commitments, key action areas, and strategies to drive sustainability while ensuring alignment with national and international environmental regulations.
declaration.declaration: Allchem Lifescience Pvt. Ltd. embeds environmental responsibility into its operations by reducing its environmental impact, enhancing resource efficiency, and maintaining full compliance with all applicable environmental regulations. With 2022 as the baseline year, we advance sustainability through cutting-edge innovations, eco-efficient manufacturing, and strategic partnerships to fulfill our long-term environmental targets.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all aspects of our operations, including manufacturing facilities, research and development activities, supply chains, and corporate offices. It extends to employees, contractors, suppliers, and business partners involved in our processes, ensuring that environmental responsibility is upheld across all levels of our business.

focusAreas: Promoting Sustainable Material Use and Waste Management
Sustainable Product use and end-of life management

Enhancing Energy Efficiency: Improve energy efficiency in API intermediate manufacturing by integrating sustainable practices, optimizing processes, and implementing energy-efficient technologies.
Reducing GHG Emissions: Lower scope 3 GHG emissions through supplier engagement, sustainable raw material sourcing, optimized transportation, and improved waste management practices.
Strengthing Water Conservation and Reuse: Optimize water use in API intermediate synthesis by integrating water-efficient technologies and improving solvent recovery processes.
Air Quality Improvements: To achieve improvements in air quality by using low-emission solvents, advanced filtration, optimized ventilation, and strict regulatory compliance.
Promoting Sustainable Material Use and W: Minimize hazardous waste generation by adopting green chemistry principles and optimizing material use in API intermediate synthesis.
Chemical Management: Strengthen chemical risk management by implementing stricter safety protocols, regular monitoring, and employee training on hazardous substance handling.
Protecting Biodiversity: Minimize the ecological impact of API intermediate manufacturing by preventing chemical runoff.
Ensuring Customer Health and Safety: Enhance the safety of API intermediates by eliminating hazardous contaminants and ensuring compliance with international safety standards.
Sustainable Product use and end-of life: Develop clear usage and disposal guidelines for API intermediates to minimize environmental contamination and ensure regulatory compliance.
Driving Environmental Advocacy and Aware: Launch an awareness campaign to educate supply chain partners and customers on the environmental impact of API intermediates and encourage sustainable usage.

targets.target: Power 35% of our production facilities with solar energy
Reduce VOC emissions from API intermediate production by 25%
Maintain 100% compliance with national and international air quality standards

quantitative.area: Promoting Sustainable Material Use and Waste Management

targets.target: Utilize 30% of materials from recycled or sustainable sources
Ensure 45% of chemicals used in production meet green chemistry principles
Increase green cover by planting 100 native trees annually
Develop safer and more sustainable formulations for 100% of API intermediates

quantitative.area: Sustainable Product use and end-of life management

targets.target: Reduce environmental impact by ensuring that at least 40% of packaging materials used for API intermediates are recyclable or biodegradable
Recover and safely manage 50% of obsolete API intermediates through take-back and recycling initiatives
Conduct annual sustainability training sessions, aiming for 90% employee participation

responsibilities.duty: Oversees the implementation and compliance of Allchem's environmental policies, ensuring alignment with regulatory standards and corporate sustainability goals.
Integrate sustainability principles into all projects, ensuring that environmental considerations are embedded from the planning phase through execution.
Adhere to established environmental standards and actively contribute to resource efficiency and sustainable practices in their daily operations.

policy.monitoring:
The Environmental Management Policy will be reviewed once in a two years, or more frequently if deemed necessary by the Environmental Manager, to ensure it remains current with regulatory changes, technological advancements, and industry best practices.

Regular internal audits and assessments will be conducted to measure performance against environmental targets, with findings reported to senior management for action.

Feedback from stakeholders, including employees, contractors, regulatory bodies, and the community, will be actively sought and incorporated to enhance environmental initiatives and address any concerns.
